reminder.notes:
Release v2.24.0

### Features
- Completely redesigned Categories tab as a grid view featuring themed category icons and inline Edit/Delete actions. Deletion warning checks for active reminders, automatically falling back to General category.
- Completely redesigned Upcoming screen with chronological groupings (Overdue, Today, Tomorrow, This Week, Later, Location & Other) with item count badges for streamlined planning.
- Added a premium segmented sliding view controller to smoothly switch between List View and Calendar View in the Upcoming tab.
- Redesigned Status and Category filter scroll bars into high-contrast, outline-washed capsule chips that color-coordinate with category accent colors.
- Implemented adaptive themed launcher icons on Android, dynamically setting a white background in light mode and a black background in dark mode.

### Bug fixes
- Resolved deprecated withOpacity calls, replacing them with modern withValues API to ensure compilation warning compliance.
- Fixed a text baseline alignment rendering issue on the category grid card layout.

mirrordrive.notes:
Release v0.13.8+33

### Features
- Added Google Drive rename detection to avoid uploading modified/renamed files from scratch.
- Added custom ignore pattern manager in Settings to filter sync folders/files line-by-line.
- Added CPU wakelock to keep the phone awake during large background or interactive syncs.
- Implemented Google Drive resumable streaming uploads in constant memory, preventing Out-Of-Memory (OOM) errors for large files.
- Run duplicate files deletion in the background with a real-time progress card in the app.

### Bug fixes
- None.

twinclean.notes:
Show the app version and PNSJY branding in Settings

Settings now ends with the current app version and the PNSJY store branding, so every
PNSJY app presents the same footer.

### Features

  last two items, consistent across all PNSJY apps.

### Bug fixes

No user-facing bug fixes in this release.
